tire marks as enduring traces of motion

alternative_interpretations: The smoke may simply result from mechanical friction during acceleration, with no symbolic intent.
limitations: No textual or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; interpretation relies solely on visual juxtaposition.

alternative_interpretations: The driver is merely operating a vehicle; the cabin enclosure serves only aerodynamic and safety functions.
limitations: Facial expression and intent are indiscernible; agency is inferred from posture alone.
